target.title: Align cost and token metrics by period
target.body:
## Summary

- reorder cost-history KPIs so current/latest values share the left column and historical values share the right column
- preserve the existing token/request ordering for providers that report request counts instead of latest tokens
- update focused dashboard assertions for one-day, seven-day, 30-day, custom, and Codex labels

## Why

The two-column SwiftUI grid renders KPIs in row-major order. The previous `Today`, `30d cost`, `30d tokens`, `Latest tokens` sequence split related time periods diagonally across the grid.

The new `Today`, `30d cost`, `Latest tokens`, `30d tokens` sequence makes each column represent one time horizon and is easier to scan at a glance.

## Verification

- focused SwiftFormat lint — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed
- portable `make check` gates and repository-wide SwiftFormat — passed
- GitGuardian Security Checks — passed
- focused Swift test and SwiftLint could not run locally because this Mac only has standalone Command Line Tools; the required `BuildServerProtocol` and SourceKit frameworks are unavailable without full Xcode

Fixes #2294
